title: Th' Quartermaster
subtitle: Chart yer coverage an' spy what ye be missin'.

coverage.fetching: Fetchin' discographies in th' background. Coverage will fill in shortly.
coverage.empty: No coverage yet. Once yer hoards finish syncin' an' discographies be fetched, yer coverage appears here.

libraries.title: Hoards in coverage
libraries.hint: Uncheck a hoard t' leave it out o' th' coverage math.

artists.title: Yer artists
artists.subtitle: Open an artist t' see which treasures ye be missin'.
artists.empty: No artists yet. Sync a hoard t' get started.

artist.noMissing: Ye have every release we know about fer this artist.
artist.noMbid: No MusicBrainz match fer this artist yet, so coverage ain't available.
artist.loadFailed: Couldn't load coverage fer this artist.

album.noTracks: No tracklist available fer this treasure yet.

discover.subtitle: Hunt all o' shanties t' spy artists an' treasures ye don't have yet.
discover.hint: Type at least 2 characters t' hunt.
discover.noResults: No matches. Try a different hunt.

follows.title: Followin'
follows.subtitle: Artists ye follow. New releases surface in yer missin' list automatically.
follows.empty: Ye be not followin' anyone yet. Open an artist in Discover an' tap Follow.

download.noLibrary: No plunder-enabled hoard yet. Set up Prowlarr + qBittorrent on a hoard first.
download.notEnabled: Booty ain't enabled on that hoard.
download.ackMessage: Chordia ships no indexers or trackers. Booty use th' Prowlarr an' qBittorrent ye configured, an' ye be responsible fer th' legality o' what ye acquire in yer jurisdiction.

queue.title: Booty
queue.subtitle: Yer plunder activity.
queue.empty: No booty yet. Hit Plunder on a missin' treasure t' start one.
queue.pickHint: We weren't sure which release be th' exact treasure, so pick th' right one.
queue.selectFailed: Couldn't pin that source — th' job may have moved on. Refresh an' pick again.

settings.title: Quartermaster's riggin'
settings.subtitle: Quality profiles an' per-hoard plunder status.
settings.profilesHint: Booty always pick th' best available source within a profile's allowed formats.
settings.librariesHint: Enable booty by configurin' Prowlarr + qBittorrent in each hoard's chordia-library.toml.
settings.destinationHelp: Where new plunder requests land. Hearties' hoards appear here when they've given ye request access.

upgrade.queued: Upgrade check queued — watch Booty. If a strictly better source exists it'll plunder; otherwise th' job ends quietly.
upgrade.inProgress: An upgrade or plunder fer this treasure be already in flight.
upgrade.notIdentified: This treasure ain't matched t' MusicBrainz yet, so thar be nothin' reliable t' hunt fer.
